description: This source file defines the PdfOutline class, representing an outline or bookmark in a PDF document. It includes properties and methods for managing outline items, their hierarchy, appearance, destinations, and serialization. The file appears to be a component of a PDF processing library, specifically for creating, reading, or modifying PDF outlines/bookmarks.

classes.name: PdfOutline
classes.description: Represents an outline (bookmark) item in a PDF document. Supports hierarchy, appearance customization, destinations, and serialization.

classes.name: PdfOutline.Keys
classes.description: Contains constant keys used in the PDF outline dictionary structure.
